findings.observation: Five commands exposed by the canonical scripts.diagrams router cannot import the repository scripts package unless PYTHONPATH is supplied externally.
findings.method: Run each command as documented: .venv/bin/python -m scripts.diagrams <command> --help with PYTHONPATH unset.
findings.expected: Every command advertised by python -m scripts.diagrams --help reaches its argparse help and exits 0 from the repository root.
findings.actual: check-quality-gates, check-padding, fix-svg-styles, fix-pagebreaks, and render-desc-indexes exit 1 with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts'. The other 25 advertised commands reach help successfully.
findings.impact: The documented quality-gate route and direct CI-style script invocation can fail before evaluating diagram correctness, leaving a release-integrity control unavailable.

evidence.observation: The router dispatches the quality-gate target as a direct Python script; the child exits 1.

evidence.command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/bioetl-audit-uv-cache uv run --frozen python -m scripts.diagrams check-quality-gates --help
evidence.observation: SCRIPT_DIR is added to sys.path, but repository root is not; importing scripts.diagrams.core fails.

findings.root_cause: The five direct-script targets import the repository package before putting the repository root on sys.path; their ImportError fallbacks repeat the same failing import.
findings.remediation: Bootstrap repository-root imports consistently in the five script targets and add a subprocess regression test with PYTHONPATH removed.
findings.automation: Subprocess architecture test for router targets with PYTHONPATH absent.
